description: Real review cases for the Cortex Agent reviewer-backend contract. Every case reproduces a defect class that actually occurred in this repository's history and asserts the finding set mechanically — no LLM judge, no network. The candidate is a reviewer backend: it is given a raw findings document and has to produce a guided-review artifact that conforms to the published schema, keeps the findings that deserve to be kept, and drops the ones that do not.

cases.description: `scripts/test-runner.cjs` shipped two defects that a review has to catch: the runner handed NODE_TEST_CONTEXT to its child processes, and `node --test` then produced no TAP output and exited 0 even when the test failed (a false green in CI); and the retry diagnostic announced a successful exclusive re-run even when the re-run had failed too. The case also pins the contract: a finding outside the reviewed changeset, a finding with an unknown risk level and a finding missing `intent` must all be dropped rather than reported.

findings.title: NODE_TEST_CONTEXT 泄漏给子进程导致失败被伪装成通过
findings.intent: 让子进程的失败真实反映到父进程退出码
findings.summary: runner 从测试上下文启动时把 NODE_TEST_CONTEXT 传给子进程，node --test 因此不输出 TAP 且失败也退出 0，runner 会把没看到的结果当绿灯。
findings.impact: CI 全绿但断言从未执行，回归可以静默合入。
follow_ups: 在 childEnv 中剥离 NODE_TEST_CONTEXT

findings.title: 独占重跑失败时仍提示重跑通过
findings.intent: 让重试诊断如实反映结果
findings.summary: 重试也失败时输出仍写着独占重跑通过，把真失败报成通过。
findings.impact: 假红排查方向被误导，真实失败被吞掉。
follow_ups: 重跑失败时改写提示文案

findings.title: 重试退避在同步路径上使用阻塞等待
findings.intent: 避免同步路径占用事件循环
findings.summary: 同步退避改用 Atomics.wait，比 sleep 更可控。
findings.impact: 同步路径不会长时间占用事件循环。

findings.title: 审查了本次改动之外的文件
findings.summary: 该文件不在本次 changeset 内，不应出现在审查结论里。
findings.impact: 审查范围被污染，结论无法归因到本次改动。

findings.title: 风险等级用了契约之外的值
findings.summary: 风险等级写成 blocker，而契约只接受 low/medium/high/critical。
findings.impact: 风险统计失真，artifact 不符合已发布 schema。

findings.title: 缺少意图说明的 finding
findings.summary: 没有写明这条 finding 想解决什么问题。
findings.impact: 无法判断该 finding 是否真的指向本次改动。

cases.description: `.agent/skills/runtime-evidence/SKILL.md` linked to `docs/reliability/verification-templates.md` and to a workflow path. The L1 templates do not publish `docs/`, so both links are dead for every project that receives the template — the defect survived one round of distribution repair and came back on the next sync. The case also pins the file-existence check: a finding that cites a file which is not present in the workspace must be dropped, not reported.
